dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses COPY includes with .INC extension, CALL to ORCA runtime subprograms (ORCSMKPASS, ORCSGETTEMP, ORCSPRGOPTION), and file assignment via ASGNPARA pattern typical of ORCA system.
evidence: no EXEC CICS / no EXEC SQL / no COMP-3

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical receipt (Yakujo/prescription) printing system - specifically a drug prescription list print component (HCN31, 6-item display for prescription list printing)
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It generates printed output for a drug prescription (Yakujo) list, formatting patient information, drug names, dosage, comments, and hospital details into a print layout. It reads master data (hospital info, staff info, drug masters, point masters) and formats them for output via a print file.

notable_features: 28 COPY statements for modular include files (.INC pattern)
21 CALL statements to ORCA runtime subprograms
LINKAGE SECTION with SPA-AREA (session/state area) and ONPRTDATA
REDEFINES used for address/name splitting and numeric decomposition
OCCURS clauses for multi-line drug/comment arrays
Image file handling (medimage directory, transparent.jpg, CPORCSMIAREA.INC)
Temporary file name acquisition via ORCSGETTEMP
Program option parameter retrieval via ORCSPRGOPTION
Japanese text in comments (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoded, rendered as latin-1 mojibake)
Fixed-format source with max line length 74
verdict.notes: Comment text is Japanese encoded in EUC-JP (or possibly Shift-JIS), decoded as latin-1 producing mojibake. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 86799 bytes total. The file is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system used widely in Japanese medical clinics. Version history shows revisions from 2009 through 2014 (v04.08.01).
